signature_matches.name: find data using regex in .NET
signature_matches.description: data-manipulation/regex
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: find data using regex in .NET
    namespace: data-manipulation/regex
    authors:
      - michael.hunhoff@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: call
  features:
    - or:
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::Matches
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::Match
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::IsMatch
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::EnumerateMatches
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::Replace
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::Split
      - api: System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex::ctor

signature_matches.name: contains PDB path
signature_matches.description: executable/pe/pdb

rule:
  meta:
    name: contains PDB path
    namespace: executable/pe/pdb
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:

  features:

signature_matches.name: obfuscated with Dotfuscator
signature_matches.description: anti-analysis/obfuscation
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: obfuscated with Dotfuscator
    namespace: anti-analysis/obfuscation
    authors:
      - jakub.jozwiak@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    att&ck:
      - Defense Evasion::Obfuscated Files or Information [T1027]
    mbc:
      - Anti-Static Analysis::Executable Code Obfuscation [B0032]
    references:
      - https://www.preemptive.com/products/dotfuscator/
    examples:
      - 2dae11cc5f86f5399b560b8837c26274b7e09431deed669b0844fef44e917915
  features:
    - and:
      - match: compiled to the .NET platform
      - string: "DotfuscatorAttribute"
